title: Rebecca Guay
description: "When I saw STAR WARS for the first time, I knew only one thing: I never, ever, wanted it to end," recalls Rebecca Guay. "To a shy little kid who was mostly a dreamer, and didn't do much of anything else except draw, STAR WARS was the best damned thing (Disney World being a close second) that I had ever seen" The extremely talented Ms. Guay was born and raised in northern Massachusetts. She graduated from Pratt Institute with a major in illustration, and now lives and works in Park Slope, Brooklyn.
